analysis:
Both units are base-side excerpts of EngineV2ProductionWiringTests.swift (a test-only file). The patch changes only test code: the recordServerStream helper now also skips .toolCallDelta events (line ~312), makeThinkProbeEngine gains a modelType parameter (lines ~1308 and ~1322 of base), and head adds a parametrized test (qwen3_5 and qwen3_5_moe with a plain prompt tail) at head lines 1363-1389. The excerpt shows no production code, no key handling, no attestation, no coordinator authorization, no cache-scope or SSD changes, and no network or storage behavior.

The base text reviewed covers KV reslice, grant, unload and heartbeat tests, plus request-routing tests. These exercise existing fail-closed tool_choice validation, cacheSalt plumbing (T-041 context; the tests note the prefix cache is off in production) and local acquire/release. The patch does not weaken those assertions.

One open point for integration: the patch adds a .toolCallDelta event case, which implies production-side changes elsewhere (MLXServerGenerationEvent and tool-call streaming). Those changes are not in the supplied units. Whether streaming tool-call deltas preserve the forced tool_choice validation that the base tests assert (no visible text before a validated call) must be checked in the production source. The test-side change just ignores deltas in the helper. I found no security regression in the supplied evidence, and coverage of the head patch is limited because the excerpt is truncated.
